profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Sign up as a vendor and introduce your business: category, location, pricing and services. The Free plan includes one listing.

faq.title: A few things you might be wondering.

find.q: How do I find the right vendor?
find.a: Search <vendors>Vendors</vendors> by service, location and date, or scroll <explore>Explore</explore> for ideas. Open any profile to see their work, pricing and packages, and save the ones you like.

contact.q: How do I contact a vendor?
contact.a: Open the vendor's profile and tap Send Inquiry. Add your date and a few details about your event. Their reply comes to your inbox, where you can keep the conversation going.

checked.a: Every listing is reviewed by the Vendora team before it appears. Vendors who also verify their documents show a verified badge on their profile.

booking.q: How does booking and payment work?
booking.a: Your vendor sends you a proposal. You can review and sign it online, then pay securely through Vendora.

join.q: Can I join as a vendor?
join.a: Yes. <signup>Sign up as a vendor</signup>, create your listing and add your work. The Free plan includes one listing, and your listing goes live once it's approved.

other.a: Visit the <help>Help centre</help> or email <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email>. Real people read every message.
